_readme: Single source of truth for crop pages, the Season Band component, and the comparison table on /crops. Every field marked verify:true is NOT confirmed by the client and renders as [VERIFY] / provisional in the UI — do not remove the flag without a client-confirmed value. Season assignment (which of the two seasons each crop is planted in) is a provisional agronomic estimate, not a client-confirmed fact: the source profile states only that 'roughly three crops' are intercropped per season, not which three. planting/harvest positions are qualitative (early/mid/late within a season), not exact dates.

B.label: Season B
B.note: Longer rains fall in Season B.

crops.name: Maize

seasonNote.value: Grown in both seasons at Normah.

crops.useNote: Feed and food grade, grown across both seasons.
crops.bodyNote: Maize is planted in both Season A and Season B on Normah's Amuru fields, taking advantage of Uganda's bimodal rainfall to spread harvest across the year rather than concentrating risk in a single crop cycle.

crops.name: Soya beans

seasonNote.value: Grown in both seasons at Normah.

crops.primaryMarket: Export — a named crop in Normah's export mix
crops.useNote: Oilseed and feed markets, rotated with cereals for soil nitrogen.
crops.bodyNote: Soya beans are part of Normah's rotation with cereal crops, supporting the soil-first agronomy the farm uses in place of continuous single-crop planting.

crops.name: Rice

seasonNote.value: Positioned in Season B, when rainfall is heaviest.

crops.useNote: Grown in the wetter half of the year, supported by borehole irrigation.
crops.bodyNote: Rice is grown in Season B, when Amuru's longer rains and the farm's borehole and irrigation water tower together support the crop's higher water demand.

crops.name: Sesame

seasonNote.value: A second-season crop in Normah's rotation.

crops.primaryMarket: Export — named as simsim in regional and Middle East trade
crops.useNote: Also called simsim; one of the six crops that set Normah apart from maize-and-soy peers.
crops.bodyNote: Sesame, known locally as simsim, is one of the crops where Normah's breadth stands out against operations that concentrate on maize and soya alone.

crops.name: Sorghum

seasonNote.value: Grown in both seasons at Normah.

crops.useNote: A drought-tolerant cereal grown across both seasons.
crops.bodyNote: Sorghum's tolerance for dry spells makes it a steady presence across both of Normah's growing seasons.

crops.name: Millet
crops.useNote: A traditional northern Uganda cereal, part of the farm's six-crop breadth.
crops.bodyNote: Millet rounds out Normah's crop breadth alongside sorghum and sesame, three crops most maize-and-soy focused peers don't carry.

seasonNote.value: Planned addition to the crop mix; no confirmed planting season yet.
